b1-22-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Maybe It Rains
b1-22-01.scenario: Petra asks whether you can go hiking tomorrow. You (Meg) say that it is possible that it will rain tomorrow, and that maybe you will stay at home.
b1-22-01.prompt: Tell Petra that it may rain tomorrow and what you might do.
cues: Say that rain is possible tomorrow
Say what you might do instead
b1-22-01.target: Lehet, hogy holnap esik az eső. Talán otthon maradunk.
b1-22-01.english: It is possible that it will rain tomorrow. Maybe we will stay at home.
b1-22-01.canDo: I can say that something is possible, using lehet, hogy.

b1-22-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Weekend Forecast
b1-22-02.scenario: Petra asks what the weather will be like at the weekend. You (Meg) say that, according to the forecast, it will rain at the weekend, but that there will hardly be any snow.
b1-22-02.prompt: Tell Petra what the forecast says about rain and snow.
b1-22-02.target: Az előrejelzés szerint a hétvégén esni fog az eső. Hó aligha lesz.
b1-22-02.english: According to the forecast, it will rain at the weekend. There will hardly be any snow.
b1-22-02.canDo: I can make a prediction, using fog + infinitive.

b1-22-03.title: Communicative Challenge: I Doubt It
b1-22-03.scenario: Petra says that the exam will be easy. You (Meg) say that you doubt it, but that you trust that it will go well.
b1-22-03.prompt: Tell Petra that you doubt the exam will be easy and that you trust it will go well.
cues: Say that you trust it will go well
b1-22-03.target: Kétlem, hogy könnyű lesz a vizsga. Bízom benne, hogy jól fog menni.
b1-22-03.english: I doubt that the exam will be easy. I trust that it will go well.
b1-22-03.canDo: I can say that I doubt something, using kétlem, hogy.

b1-22-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Will Károly Come?
b1-22-04.scenario: Petra asks whether Károly will come to the party. You (Meg) say that it is conceivable that he will come, but that it is out of the question that he will come early.
b1-22-04.prompt: Tell Petra what is conceivable and what is out of the question.
cues: Say that it is conceivable that he comes to the party
Say that it is out of the question that he comes early
b1-22-04.target: Elképzelhető, hogy Károly eljön a buliba. Kizárt dolog, hogy korán jön.
b1-22-04.english: It is conceivable that Károly will come to the party. It is out of the question that he will come early.
b1-22-04.canDo: I can say that something is conceivable or out of the question, using elképzelhető and kizárt dolog.

b1-22-05.title: Communicative Challenge: In Case It Rains
b1-22-05.scenario: Petra is planning a picnic in the park. You (Meg) say that you will bring an umbrella in case it rains.
b1-22-05.prompt: Tell Petra what you will bring and for which case.
cues: Say for which case you bring it
b1-22-05.target: Hozok esernyőt arra az eshetőségre, ha esik az eső.
b1-22-05.english: I am bringing an umbrella in case it rains.
b1-22-05.canDo: I can say what to prepare for, using arra az eshetőségre, ha.

b1-22-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Inventor's Plan
b1-22-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Dávid is about. You (Meg) say that Dávid has a big machine and that in the end his plan comes true.
b1-22-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Dávid has and what happens to his plan.
cues: Say that his plan comes true in the end
b1-22-consolidation.target: Dávidnak van egy nagy gépe. Végül valóra válik a terve.
b1-22-consolidation.english: Dávid has a big machine. In the end his plan comes true.
b1-22-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about an inventor and his plan in a few sentences.
